text:
```yaml
name: Downstream Compatibility

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --extra dev --extra test

      - name: Run downstream compatibility tests
        run: |
          uv run pytest \
            --cov=src \
            --cov-report=xml \
            -m downstream_compat \
            -v \
            tests/downstream_compat/
```
